verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਹੁ ਛਡਿ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਵੈ ਆਗੂ ਨੋ ਭੁਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: raahu chhadd ujhaR pavai aagoo no bhulaa kar jaanai|

en.bdb: He who leaving the path away follows a trackless waste and considers his leader gone astray, is a fool.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੇੜੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਹਾਲੀਐ ਕੁਦਿ ਪਵੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਹਣ ਧਿਙਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: beRe vich bahaaleeaai kudh pavai vich vahan dhin(g)aanai|

en.bdb: Seated in the boat he jumps impulsively into the current.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਘੜਾਂ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਹਿਠਿਆਂ ਬੋਲਿਵਿਗਾੜਿ ਉਘਾੜਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: sughaRaa(n) vich bahiThiaa(n) bolivigaaR ughaaR vakhaanai|

en.bdb: Sitting among the noble ones he, due to his ill talk stands exposed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਘੜਾਂ ਮੂਰਖ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਰਤੀਹਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: sughaRaa(n) moorakh jaanadhaa aap sughaR hoi virateehaanai|

en.bdb: The wise he considers stupid and hids his own conduct as a clever one.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਿਹ ਨੋ ਰਾਤਿ ਵਖਾਣਦਾ ਚਾਮਚੜਿਕ ਜਿਵੇਂ ਟਾਨਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: dheh no raat vakhaanadhaa chaamachaRik jive(n) Taanaanai|

en.bdb: Like , a bat and a glow worm he describes the day as night.
The wisdom of Gum never resides in the heart of a foolish person.
